name: Embed SDK tests

on:
  push:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  browser:
    name: Embed ${{ matrix.browser }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        browser: [chromium, firefox, webkit]
    env:
      BROWSER: none
      HISTOIRE_EMBED_BROWSER: ${{ matrix.browser }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4.0.0
      - name: Get pnpm store directory
        id: pnpm-cache
        run: echo "pnpm_cache_dir=$(pnpm store path)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.pnpm-cache.outputs.pnpm_cache_dir }}
          key: pnpm-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pnpm-v1-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build dependency graph
        run: pnpm run build
      - name: Test portable and native packages
        if: matrix.browser == 'chromium'
        run: |
          pnpm --filter @histoire/protocol test
          pnpm --filter @histoire/sdk test
          pnpm --filter @histoire/vue test
      - name: Install browser
        run: pnpm --filter histoire exec playwright install --with-deps ${{ matrix.browser }}
      - name: Complete Chromium embed suite
        if: matrix.browser == 'chromium'
        run: pnpm --filter histoire test:embed:integration
      - name: Firefox and WebKit embed smoke
        if: matrix.browser != 'chromium'
        run: pnpm --filter histoire test:embed:integration bridge-origins bridge-lifecycle preview-grid controls-overlays vue-host-isolation src/node/__tests__/embed/integration/host-channels.spec.ts
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: failure()
        with:
          name: embed-${{ matrix.browser }}-screenshots
          path: /tmp/histoire-sdk-*.png
          if-no-files-found: ignore
  consumers:
    name: Packed SDK consumers
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      BROWSER: none
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4.0.0
      - name: Get pnpm store directory
        id: pnpm-cache
        run: echo "pnpm_cache_dir=$(pnpm store path)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ steps.pnpm-cache.outputs.pnpm_cache_dir }}
          key: pnpm-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('**/pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: pnpm-v1-${{ runner.os }}-
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Build published package shape
        run: pnpm run build
      - name: Install consumer Chromium
        run: pnpm --filter histoire exec playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Run accessibility browser checks
        run: pnpm --filter @histoire/plugin-a11y test:browser
      - name: Run packed consumer smoke
        run: pnpm --filter histoire test:embed:consumers

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
